_doc: 第一章對話肖像清單（roadmap §5.1）。與 chapter01_assets.json 共用風格（扁平幾何無五官，美術聖經 §1.1 2026-09-09 修訂）與色票；framing 為胸像。資產 id 前綴 portrait_，尺寸上限見 data/art_limits.json。無五官一視同仁——殖民者也沒有臉（美術聖經 §0）。用法：python art/scripts/generate_batch.py --manifest art/manifest/chapter01_portraits.json --stage flat --batch 2；挑選：select_masters.py 目前只讀 chapter01_assets.json，肖像用 --manifest 支援待補。

shared.style: STYLE: minimalist flat geometric vector illustration. Every shape is a clean flat polygon or smooth cut-out with hard edges; forms are built from a few large flat facets with a single straight split between the lit side (upper left) and a shaded side one step darker. Two or three flat tones per object, no outlines, no gradients, no texture, no brush strokes, no highlights. Bold readable silhouette, poster-flat.
shared.palette: PALETTE: terracotta #B5442E, deep ochre #8C3A22, banyan green #2F5B3A, ink green #1E4029, jade #5C8A4A, sand #C9A96B, sun-bleached sand #D9C08E, oyster-lime white #E8DCC6, indigo #2C5470, tidal teal #3E7A94, gamboge #E0A93B, cinnabar #A8332B, burnt umber linework #3A2A22.
shared.negative_base: eyes, pupils, mouth, teeth, nose, eyebrows, facial features, realistic face, outline, gradient, texture, shading, photorealism, 3D render

style_by_cat.portrait: The face is ONE smooth featureless flat shape with no eyes, no mouth, no nose, no eyebrows drawn — the only detail on the face is the vertical light/dark split. Hair, beard, hat, helmet and collar are flat faceted shapes. Hands are simple mitten shapes.

framing.portrait: bust portrait of a single character, head and shoulders, facing the viewer straight on, perfectly symmetrical, centered and filling the frame, isolated on a plain flat dark slate background.

assets.name: 肖像：揆一
assets.subject: Frederick Coyett, governor of Dutch Formosa in 1661. Shoulder-length wavy hair and a pointed beard, a black coat with a wide flat white collar forming a square shoulder line. Fair skin tone.

assets.name: 肖像：陳澤
assets.subject: Chen Ze, a Ming loyalist general of Koxinga's army. A Ming helmet with a tall plume, vermillion mountain-pattern lamellar armour with bronze-gold trim at the shoulders, a short dark beard. Medium warm skin tone.

assets.name: 肖像：西拉雅頭目
assets.subject: a Siraya village elder of 17th-century Formosa. Hair tied up in a knot, NO hat, a shell ear ornament, bare shoulders with a deerskin wrap, holding upright beside the head a rattan staff of office with a silver head. Deep brown skin tone.

assets.name: 肖像：VOC 奴工
assets.subject: an enslaved labourer in the Dutch fort of Formosa, of South Indian or Southeast Asian origin. Short cropped hair, bare shoulders, a plain cloth wrap, a heavy sack strap across one shoulder. Very dark skin tone.

assets.name: 肖像：新港社鏢手
assets.subject: a young Siraya hunter of 17th-century Formosa. Hair tied up in a knot, a shell ear ornament, bare shoulders, a gamboge yellow woven band on the upper arm, the shaft of a long bamboo javelin resting against one shoulder. Deep brown skin tone.

assets.name: 肖像：大員街民
assets.subject: a Han Chinese settler woman of Tayouan town, 1661. Hair in a low bun with a plain cloth headwrap, an indigo blue short jacket with a cloth-knot fastening, a bundle strap over one shoulder. Medium warm skin tone.
